name: beevibe
description: Beevibe Claude Code plugins. Currently: Architecture Deep Research and Crystal Ball.

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Architecture Deep Research — scan a repo, draft a PRD, run live deep research, get a cited handoff. Use when picking a topology, retrieval architecture, event bus, storage engine, auth pattern, or any system-design decision before code lands.

plugins.name: crystal
plugins.description: Crystal Ball — publish your current Claude Code session as a queryable capsule. Visitors get a share URL; the capsule answers in your voice, with the full session as context. Use when the user says "share this session", "publish this as a crystal", or invokes /crystal:publish.
